Fetch only requested years present in that authoritative index, passing the URL unchanged to the supplied callback. Return {"downloaded": {year: callback_result}, "missing": [unpublished requested years]} with missing years sorted. Deduplicate requested years. Do not fabricate URLs, retry unpublished years, or invent data for missing periods.

from ingest import run
index={2011:'https://agency.example.invalid/2011.data',2013:'https://agency.example.invalid/2013-final.data'};calls=[]
def fetch(url):
 assert url in index.values(),'Unpublished or guessed URL requested';calls.append(url);return 'data:'+url
r=run(index,[2013,2012,2011,2012,2015],fetch)
assert r['downloaded']=={2011:'data:'+index[2011],2013:'data:'+index[2013]}
assert r['missing']==[2012,2015] and sorted(calls)==sorted(index.values())
